name: jev-belay
description: Stop hook that blocks an unverified done: reads the turn's evidence, then asks Jev once

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Without a key the hook reads nothing and blocks nothing, so this is the one setting it needs.

threshold.title: claims_done threshold
threshold.description: How sure Jev has to be that the turn reported the work as done before a stop is blocked.

shadow.title: Shadow mode
shadow.description: Show what would have been blocked without blocking

check.title: Own check command
check.description: A regex for a check script the built-in list does not know, e.g. ^\./check\.sh
